rules: All dataset dialogues and turns stay in the denominator; require matching IDs, turn indices and exact user text.
Expected state or explicitly annotated allowed_states; corresponding recommendation presence.
All shown IDs exist, are unique, satisfy dataset spoken constraints, exact IDs and forbidden IDs.
Active Query equality and forbidden fields are separate diagnostics, never observable-delivery ground truth.
Legacy saved score remains a separately named historical lane; no errata is applied implicitly.
Explanation template audit is separately reported and never substitutes for relevance or success.
limitations: Post-hoc maintained version of supplemental observable-delivery-v1 on inspected synthetic DEV.
Measures compliance with stated preferences, not latent satisfaction or human usefulness.
Expected clarification necessity is a dataset annotation, not inferred by this scorer.
Repeated data do not establish independent generalization; no final holdout or BLIND access.
Saved report replay performs no inference and yields no fresh latency/load measurement.
